messages:
maria: Quick check — are the quickstarts + sample apps on track for tomorrow's docs release? we need changelog cutoff by EOD.
jon: Blocked on sample-go CI: getting 401 on auth integration tests. PR up: https://github.com/redwood/sample-go/pull/42 — needs env var fix.
asha: Docs are ready except streaming example; I need a tiny JS snippet showing streaming tokens from the SDK.
kevin: I can publish a patch release of the JS SDK once the sample-js PR lands. ETA ~2hrs.
sam: sample-java needs a Gradle plugin bump for the new artifact coordinates. I can open the PR but will need a reviewer for the pom change.
oliver: sample-python is green, I updated the README to include new quickstart flags. pushed to main.
build-bot: CI report: sample-go (job 791) failing auth.mock -> 401. rerun queued.
jon: thanks — env var name mismatch between README and CI secrets (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY). fixing README now.
maria: Important: changelog cutoff = EOD for code changes. doc-only edits allowed post-cutoff but call them out in the PR body.
asha: @kevin quick question: can the streaming snippet use `client.stream()` pattern from v2? we need to match published SDK API.
kevin: yes — example: ``const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-v1', messages }); for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta); }`` will match 2.1.0. I'll add to sample-js PR.
sam: FYI sample-java PR https://github.com/redwood/sample-java/pull/18 created, requesting @jon for review.
jon: will review after fixing sample-go env.
ash a: (typo) — oops, ignore.
oliver: small ask — can we tag a release candidate for quickstarts so integrators can pin it? e.g., `quickstarts/v0.9-rc1`
maria: yes, please tag if all sample repos are green. we'll promote to release after smoke tests tomorrow morning.
deploy-bot: smoke tests scheduled 07:00 UTC tomorrow across us-west/us-east regions.
kevin: If anyone needs a hotfix, ping me on-thread and @kevin in DMs for fast cut.
jon: sample-go PR merged, CI green after README fix. rerunning sample-go integration tests.
build-bot: sample-go CI: all checks passed.
sam: sample-java CI passed unit tests, integration pending.
asha: I'll draft the streaming snippet in the docs and link to sample-js PR once kevin publishes SDK.
maria: OK — plan: changelog cutoff EOD, tag RC if all green, promote after morning smoke. call out any post-cut doc edits in PRs. anyone blocking?
oliver: none from my side. :thumbsup:
jon: nothing else.
kevin: ready to publish once PRs merged.
sam: will ping reviewers.
maria: great — thanks team. closing this thread for updates; please reply if anything regresses.
